Forbidden.description: Caller lacks the capability or entitlement.

NotFound.description: Resource does not exist or is not visible.

WebVueError.description: Contract error shape returned by api_handler with a real HTTP status.

sessionCookie.description: Odoo session cookie; browser traffic is same-origin, no bearer tokens.
sessionCookie.name: session_id

info.description: Generated surface of every /api/v1 route across the webvue Odoo addons, with contract schemas harvested from @webvue/contracts. Regenerate with `python3 tools/api_surface.py`; never edit by hand.
info.title: webvue /api/v1

get.summary: A file of a message in the conversation, for a member of it.

patch.summary: Archive or unarchive with ``active``; there is no delete.

post.summary: Plans are shared by every company of the database: stock ``account.analytic.plan`` has no company.

patch.summary: Only the name changes: moving a plan under another one rebuilds the plan columns of the analytic items.

get.summary: The asset profiles of the current company (``archived=true`` for the archived ones).

post.summary: An archived profile cannot be chosen for a new asset; the assets that use it keep running.
A draft asset on a profile: the depreciation method comes from the profile, the board when it is validated.
Posts the entry of every running asset's due depreciation line up to ``date`` (not in the future).

get.summary: An asset with its depreciation board.

post.summary: Sells or scraps a running asset: the OCA removal wizard books the last depreciation up to the date, clears the
Runs the asset (draft to running) and computes its depreciation board.
Matches the line with open items; what they leave over is booked on ``account_id``.

get.summary: Open items to match, the exact-amount ones first, then the newest; the line's partner narrows them.

post.summary: Undoes a reconciliation. The journal's reconcile mode decides how: ``edit`` removes the matching and the
A bank statement with its lines, on a bank journal of the current company.
Create one statement from a CSV file, whole or not at all.
Read a CSV file and write nothing.

delete.summary: Removes a statement none of whose lines is reconciled: undo the reconciliations first (422 ``has_reconciliations``).

get.summary: A bank statement with its lines.

patch.summary: Corrects the name and the opening and closing balances of a statement.

post.summary: Matches the statement's open lines that have exactly one certain item; everything else is left for review.

get.summary: Budgets of the current company, filtered by ``state`` and ``q`` (the name).

post.summary: A draft budget for a period of the current company.

patch.summary: The name, description or period of a draft budget; its lines must stay inside the period.

post.summary: Draft to confirmed: the budget and its lines are frozen.
A line on a draft budget: an account (and optionally one analytic account) and its amount for a period.
Splits the budget of one account for a period between cost centers: one line per cost center, ``amount`` times its percent.
Confirmed or cancelled back to draft, to change the lines.
Remove the reconciliation of the entry's lines (Odoo's public ``remove_move_reconcile``).
The draft debit note of a posted invoice, made by Odoo's public ``account.debit.note`` wizard.

get.summary: The stock invoice report of a posted document, rendered in the caller's own environment.

post.summary: A receipt or payment voucher that names no invoice: an advance, or money kept to be allocated later.

patch.summary: Correct a draft payment (for example one reset to draft) before it is posted again.

post.summary: Set a posted payment's unallocated balance against posted invoices or against other payments (a refund).
Undo what the payment was set against, so its whole amount is open again.

get.summary: Open balances as of ``date_to``, aged from their due date; ``kind`` is receivable (default) or payable.
Income, expense and net per cost center of the current company; ``plan_id`` limits it to a plan and its sub-plans.
The analytic items behind one row of the report (``account_id`` is required), newest first, paged.
The position at ``date_to``; the current year earnings run from the start of its fiscal year.
Per line the budget, the posted actual, the variance (budget minus actual) and that in percent of the budget.
The statement of cash flows of a period by the indirect method, from the posted journal items.
The ledger totals per account; ``account_id`` adds its lines, which ``limit``/``offset`` page (date order).
Revenue, costs, expenses and profit of a period (the MIS template ``mis_report_profit_loss``).
Debit, credit and balances per account for a period, with the totals (OCA account_financial_report).
Group taxes appear as their child taxes, cash-basis taxes at the invoice date, current company only.
The boxes of the Saudi VAT return (1 to 16) for a period, from the tax tags of the posted journal items.
The journal items behind one column (``base`` or ``tax``) of one box (``sa_1``..): drill-down to the documents.
Tax withheld from vendor payments per withholding tax, current company only.
A simplified Zakat base at ``date_to``: the formula is data and must be reviewed by a Saudi CPA.

post.summary: Adds (``add``) or deducts (``deduct``) a figure of the company to the Zakat base of the fiscal year ending ``date_to``.
Records that the caller reviewed the computation of the fiscal year ending ``date_to`` as it stands now.

get.summary: The work list of e-invoices ZATCA has not accepted (oldest first), filtered by ``state``.
The caller's own custody: the stock follower rule grants the read, the company

post.summary: Grant days to another employee; the grant is approved at once.
The bank salary file of a fixed run: employees with a net to pay, each of them with an IBAN.
The WPS file of a fixed run: every payslip, zero net included, once its totals add up.

get.summary: The caller's own planning rows in the current company.
